      "rationale": "Does not alter the kernel boundary, C API, or libbitcoinkernel design; changes to chainparams simply follow from removing the static constants."

      "name": "p2p",

      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Dynamically calculates headers presync DoS parameters at runtime and corrects an attack model inaccuracy.
